title: Embodied fly, stage 2b: does sugar input to the FlyWire brain extend a simulated proboscis through the motor neurons of each proboscis muscle, and does bitter input gate it? (SIMULATED, open loop)
status: registered before any stage-2b brain or body simulation
roadmap: report/ROADMAP_EMBODIED_FLY.md, stage 2 (feeding and walking); this is its feeding half: 'sugar drives proboscis extension and bitter suppresses it'
seen_before_registration: every earlier fly result; in particular, on FlyWire 783 under the published sugar drive the published MN9 (one neuron, right side, CB0701) fires at 76.75 Hz, and 0 Hz when bitter drive is added (fly_chip_to_animal R1 and vehicle); on the male CNS the summed proboscis motor pool fires at 31.4 Hz under sugar and 5.6 Hz with bitter added (fly_motor_readout MR1)

data only: the male-CNS names of the proboscis motor neurons and their FlyWire cell types (MN9 CB0701; MN1 CB0720; MN2Da CB0789; MN2Db CB0861; MN2V CB0783; MN4a CB0845; MN4b CB0871; MN3M CB0703; MN3L CB0875 and CB0882; MN6 CB0858; MN7 CB0762), and the pool sizes in FlyWire 783 (2, 4, 2, 2, 2, 4, 2, 2, 4, 2, 4; both sides)

literature: McKellar et al. 2020 (eLife 9:e54978): muscle 9 is a protractor of the rostrum; muscles 1, 2D and 2V retract the rostrum; muscle 4 extends the haustellum; muscle 3 flexes the haustellum; muscle 6 extends and muscle 7 abducts the labellum

body only, no neural input: the flybody model (commit d015e9b) with its free joint removed is unstable at its own 0.1 ms step and stable at 0.01 ms; negative rostrum and haustellum commands extend the proboscis (labellum-to-head distance 0.43 mm at rest, 0.78 mm with both joints commanded to their extension limits)

design.brain: the published model on FlyWire 783 (Shiu constants, w_syn 0.275 mV, no background), drive 150 Hz Poisson to each driven neuron, 1 s trials
design.pool_membership: every FlyWire 783 neuron of those cell types, both sides (the proboscis is a midline organ with bilateral muscles)
design.activation: per pool, spike trains filtered (exponential, tau 20 ms) into rates at 1 ms, averaged over the pool's neurons, divided by r_full and clipped to [0, 1]; r_full 20 Hz primary, 10 and 40 Hz as sensitivity (as stage 1)
design.commands: per joint, net = activation(extending pool) - activation(opposing pool); command = net x (extension limit) if net > 0, else |net| x (opposite limit): rostrum limits -1.24 (protraction) and 0.183; haustellum limits -1.59 (extension) and 0.7; all other actuators held at 0; commands updated every 1 ms
design.body: flybody fruitfly.xml at commit d015e9b, free joint removed (body fixed in space), simulation step 0.01 ms; the labellum (body labrum_left) to head distance; extension = that distance minus its value with all commands 0, in mm
design.full_extension: E_full: the extension after 1 s with both joints commanded to their extension limits, measured by the same code before scoring
design.readout: per trial the peak extension over the second (mm)
design.numerical_check: the full-extension run repeated at a 0.005 ms step must agree within 0.01 mm, or the stage stops

G0_silent_without_drive.statement: Without drive no proboscis motor neuron fires
G0_silent_without_drive.test: no spikes in any of the four scored pools in any no-drive trial

G1_sugar_extends_the_proboscis.statement: Sugar input extends the proboscis at least halfway, far more than bitter input, antennal input or none
G1_sugar_extends_the_proboscis.test: median peak extension under sugar >= 0.5 x E_full, and at least 0.25 x E_full above the medians under bitter, jon_ce and none (r_full 20 Hz)

G2_both_joints_are_driven_to_extend.statement: Under sugar input the published extensor of each joint outfires its antagonists
G2_both_joints_are_driven_to_extend.test: median over sugar trials of the time-averaged activation: rostrum protractor > rostrum retractor and haustellum extensor > haustellum flexor (r_full 20 Hz)

G3_bitter_gates_extension.statement: Adding bitter input to sugar input suppresses extension
G3_bitter_gates_extension.test: median peak extension under sugar_bitter <= 0.5 x the sugar median

G4_bitter_alone_does_not_extend.statement: Bitter input alone does not extend the proboscis
G4_bitter_alone_does_not_extend.test: median peak extension under bitter <= 0.25 x E_full

G5_the_activation_scale_does_not_decide_.statement: G1 and G3 hold at the other activation scales
G5_the_activation_scale_does_not_decide_.test: G1's and G3's tests hold at r_full 10 Hz and 40 Hz

reported_without_prediction: the labellum pools' rates (MN6, MN7); per drive the onset (first time above 0.5 of its own peak) of the rostrum and haustellum commands
not_claimed_even_if_all_pass: that a fly extends its proboscis this way: the body is fixed, the loop is open, joints are position-servoed rather than muscle-driven, and the motor-neuron-to-joint mapping is a stated rule built from McKellar et al. 2020; a pass means the validated brain model's motor output, read through the published muscle roles, extends a simulated proboscis under sugar and not under bitter
reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls; E_full and the numerical check reported.
